title: Baby Blanket Bliss
description: A beautifully simple baby blanket worked in super-bulky yarn for speed. A central moss stitch body is framed by a neat seed stitch border, giving a classic, heirloom feel. Perfect as a baby shower gift — knits up in just a few evenings.
yarnRequirements: 300–400g super bulky or chunky yarn (approx. 160–200m). Shown in cream.
gauge: 11 sts × 16 rows = 10 cm in moss stitch on 8 mm needles
materials: 8 mm straight or circular needles (60 cm+)

instructions.title: Cast On & Border
instructions.body: Cast on 73 sts. Row 1 (border): *k1, p1; repeat to last st, k1. Repeat this row 6 more times (7 rows total of seed stitch border).

instructions.title: Main Body
instructions.body: Set up body: Seed 7 sts, pm, work moss stitch over centre 59 sts, pm, seed 7 sts. Moss stitch: Row 1: *k1, p1; repeat. Row 2: *p1, k1; repeat. Maintain seed borders throughout. Continue until blanket measures 73 cm from cast-on.

instructions.title: Final Border & Cast Off
instructions.body: Work 7 rows of seed stitch across all sts (removing markers on first row). Cast off loosely in pattern.

instructions.title: Finishing
instructions.body: Weave in all ends securely. Wash on a gentle cycle and lay flat to dry.

reviews.author: gemma_jo
reviews.body: Made 4 of these as baby shower gifts and everyone thought I'd bought them from a shop. Brilliant free pattern, knits up so fast!

reviews.author: NanKnitter
reviews.body: Perfect for a complete beginner. This was my very first blanket and it came out wonderfully. Very easy to follow instructions.

reviews.author: StephH
reviews.body: Lovely pattern, only thing i'd say is the yarn quantity seems a bit underestimated - I needed quite a bit more than suggested. Definately buy extra just incase!

reviews.author: mum_of_3_crafts
reviews.body: So simple and so beautiful. Have made 3 now in different colours. The seed stitch border really makes it look professional.

reviews.author: David_P
reviews.body: Not bad but I found the seed stitch border quite tedious after a while haha. Good pattern overall but maybe not for someone who doesn't enjoy repetitive stitch work.

reviews.author: k_mills
reviews.body: Sweet pattern. Came up slightly smaller than the measurements stated but I think that's just my tension. Would recommend for a quick and impressive gift.
